scope: Native measured-sample Z adjustment only. Automatic probing, retries, configured product calibration and hardware acceptance remain incomplete.
checks: Three Z motors receive 0/20/40 pulses across two segments
Normal Z motion after final rebuild drives every Z motor by ten pulses
Flat bed performs zero correction pulses
Missing motor or excessive travel fails before adjustment packets
Cancellation after adjustment starts stops the whole group and clears homing

precision.limitation: Per-segment coordinate rebasing rounds each segment; total adjustment error is not bounded to half one step. Simulated firmware records accepted pulses, not real physical movement or encoder feedback.

benchmark.scope: Three Z motors, two physical segments and final coordinate rebase. Includes simulated MCU clock waits, stop confirmations and native step generation; excludes probing and setup. Not physical hardware or an equal-work Python comparison.
